SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS distinct_keys,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows, MIN(valid_from) AS min_vf, MAX(valid_from) AS max_vf
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-30' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH first_version AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT home_store_id, COUNT(*) AS new_members, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
       SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from <> join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_differs
FROM first_version
WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(home_store_id) ORDER BY 1
